inlet and inlet_panel overlap by 315.1 mm^3 near (-171.5, 22.0, 37.61).
leadscrew is drawn 12.5 mm into the 8 mm bore of z_coupler, but a shaft of that size can enter only 8.6 mm before it meets the coupler's elastomer spider: 3.9 mm too deep.

bracket_13 to part_fan_screw_1: drawn 0.48 mm apart (closest with {'x': 90.0, 'y': 90.0}). Built from purchased and purchased parts through the joints between them the gap is 0.48 +/-0.59 mm (one standard deviation) and closes in 22.0% of 3000 simulated builds (standard error 0.8%; limit 1%).

x_beam to x_endstop_nut_1: drawn 0.35 mm apart. Built from extrusion and purchased parts through the joints between them the gap is 0.35 +/-0.37 mm (one standard deviation) and closes in 17.7% of 3000 simulated builds (standard error 0.7%; limit 1%).

x_carriage to x_belt_block: drawn 0.50 mm apart. Built from purchased and printed parts through the joints between them the gap is 0.50 +/-0.26 mm (one standard deviation) and closes in 2.3% of 3000 simulated builds (standard error 0.3%; limit 1%).

Endstop x_endstop on joint x: at the min end of travel (x=-90) the striker stops 3.70 mm short of the switch's latest operating position (nominal 2.20 mm short; the operating position is nominal +/-1.5 mm unit to unit), so it is never pressed.

Endstop y_endstop on joint y: at the min end of travel (y=-90) the striker stops 3.70 mm short of the switch's latest operating position (nominal 2.20 mm short; the operating position is nominal +/-1.5 mm unit to unit), so it is never pressed.

Device 'psu_relay' needs a supply connection on its port 'N' (mains neutral: the module's own 5 V converter is fed from LIN and N; without it the relay never pulls in and the machine does not switch on), and nothing is wired to it.

1 pair(s) of parts overlap in the model without a declared thread, press fit or join (largest: inlet and inlet_panel, 315.09 mm^3). An overlap is a clash, not a seat: it is left out of the stack-up, so it cannot tighten any tolerance chain. Fix the clash (see the interference verifier) before reading the figures below.

extruder to fan_carrier: drawn 0.50 mm apart. Built from purchased and printed parts through the joints between them the gap is 0.50 +/-0.17 mm (one standard deviation) and closes in 0.17% of 3000 simulated builds (standard error 0.07%; an error above 1%).

x_rail to x_endstop_screw_1: drawn 1.30 mm apart. Built from purchased and purchased parts through the joints between them the gap is 1.30 +/-0.41 mm (one standard deviation) and closed in none of 3000 simulated builds, but its spread puts it at about 0.0008 of builds (normal estimate; an error above 1%).
x_beam to x_endstop_nut_1: designed clearance 0.35 mm between two parts that do not mate, below the 0.5 mm minimum (default for the processes: extrusion 0.5 mm, purchased 0.2 mm, the larger).

bed_probe is marked off-the-shelf but did not come from the parts catalog (dimensions and ratings unverified).

Bed probe 'bed_probe' is offset (-32, -6.19) mm from the nozzle and kept 18 mm inside the plate edge, so strips of the print area are never probed: {'x_high': 32.0, 'y_high': 6.19} (mm wide; print area not declared (design.printer['print_area']): taken as the whole XY travel over the plate, so travel added for probing counts as print area). The firmware holds the nearest measured value there.

Probe 'bed_probe' is rated for 70 degC ambient (PL-08N class value, recalled (typical, unverified)). Its face works 2.2 mm above a bed that runs up to 100 degC: the sensor is estimated at 43.6 to 71.8 degC (moving in room air to parked over the bed), and the high end is within the 10 K asked of an unvalidated estimate (margin -1.8 K).
Heater 'extruder': a shorted MOSFET is survived only because the firmware drops the supply relay (peak 282 degC). There is no cut-off that works if the controller has also hung.

A 1 kg print at the worst corner of the print area lowers the print surface there by 0.087 mm (bonded joints 0.063, screw-only joints 0.087; of which guides and nut 0.004), more than 0.1 of a 0.2 mm layer (0.020 mm). The bed is levelled and meshed empty, so neither sees it.
